subject: Sort-merge file description entry
notes: kb/Work PB345 (landed). RULE: 'One or more record description entries shall be associated with the sort-merge file description entry.' - cite.py --check 13.4.6.3 'One or more record description entries shall be associated with the sort-merge file description entry.' -> OK 13.4.6.3 2). Enforced as COBOL1837 at the SD entry. Before PB345 a record-less SD compiled and the only diagnostic it drew was the COMPILER'S OWN deferral warning - COBOL1756, "SORT 'S1' without an SD record - not implemented" - followed by a run-unit abort, i.e. the compiler announcing its own gap for the source's error. SortBinder.RecordLessSd now binds SORT, MERGE and RETURN on such a file to a no-op so the entry's error is the only diagnosis.
